summary: I reviewed Medusa 2.22.0's complete-cart workflow. The cart-level guard (acquireLockStep on the cart id) uses the default in-memory locking provider, which is per process, so it does not serialize completions across two servers sharing one database. The order_cart link is checked before the order is created with no database-level uniqueness on that link that I could confirm, so two servers could each create an order for one cart. I submitted two attempts: attempt 1 tests this cross-server race (expected one_order_per_cart to fail), and attempt 2 is a same-server control (expected to pass). I did not get the run results back, and I could not read several key files (reserve-inventory step, lock provider, link module) because of tool errors, so the hypothesis is unverified.
